{{Quote|Once upon a time there was a pirate haven on the Outer Rim called Mandellia. Thousands of criminals lived there. One bright morning Nok Drayen's freighter dropped out of hyperspace over Mandellia. He demanded the pirates surrender to him or die.|Risha Drayen|<ref name="Vault" />}}
'''Mandellia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that served as a haven for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Thousands of criminals lived on the world until one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] belonging to an obscure [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Nok Drayen]] arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and broadcasted a message demanding that the pirates surrender or [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="Vault" />

When the pirates refused, Drayen fired a single [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] at the pirate settlement&mdash;a [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] loaded with an Imperial [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]] he had stolen from the Empire. The entire population of the world, approximately ten thousand criminals, died in less than a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]]. The act, and the wealth he scavenged from the world, dead by then, turned Drayen into one of the underworld's wealthiest and most feared [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] overnight.<ref name="Vault" /> He later named a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Mandellian Gambit]]'', after the incident, and his daughter [[Risha Drayen]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] there.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mandellia was first mentioned in conversations with the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] companion character Risha Drayen in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Vault" />
